sections.content: To talk about future plans, use 'lesz' (will be) or future intent with present tense. Reflect on the day using 'jó' (good) and past descriptions.

items.spanish: Jó nap volt. Holnap is találkozunk.
items.english: It was a good day. Tomorrow we also meet.
For lunch there will be soup and apple.

items.spanish: Délben ebédelünk. A vacsora finom lesz.
items.english: At noon we eat lunch. Dinner will be delicious.

sections.content: Use 'lesz' (will be) for future descriptions. The adjective 'jó' (good) can describe both past events ('volt') and future ones ('lesz').
